title: PH vows stronger action to end violence against children by 2030
summary: MANILA, Philippines — The Philippine government has pledged to provide support across the health, education, social welfare, and justice sectors by 2030 to help eradicate violence against children.…

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Philippine government has pledged to provide support across the health, education, social welfare, and justice sectors by 2030 to help eradicate violence against children. Health Secretary Edwin Mercado made the commitment on Wednesday during the 2nd Global Ministerial Conference on Ending Violence Against Children, which the Philippines is hosting. According to the World Health Organization, more than 230 new pledges will be announced during the conference, bringing the global total to over 630 pledges from 140 countries since the inaugural event was held in Colombia in 2024.
